# ghost/contacts

Google Contacts on a device without a Google account: create, search, read and list local contacts.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/contacts
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/contacts create_contact --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/contacts search_contacts --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/contacts get_contact_details --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/contacts list_contacts --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `create_contact`: Add Ada Lovelace to my contacts with number +1 555 123 4567
- `search_contacts`: Find Ada in my contacts
- `get_contact_details`: What is Ada Lovelace's phone number?
- `list_contacts`: List all my contacts
